## Objective
Make the installer interrupt-safe: scripts/install_lib.sh has zero trap handlers in ~1,900 lines, and an interrupt mid skill-copy leaves a copy without an owner marker that is then treated as user-owned forever (defect sites install_lib.sh:1028-1049, :1096-1154). NOTE: the ticket references install_lib.sh at the repo root; the actual probed path is scripts/install_lib.sh.

## Design summary
Pre-decided: stage each skill copy into a temp dir WITH its owner marker, then move into place atomically (mv within the same filesystem); traps on INT/TERM/ERR remove the staging dir only - they must never half-clean installed state. The installer stays bash (spec decision 8 - porting is explicitly out of scope).

## File scope
Include: scripts/install_lib.sh, scripts/test_install.sh.
Exclude: installer structural rewrite, ownership semantics changes, everything else.

## Constraints
No git push or PR creation - local branch/diff only. Work repro-first: a scripted repro that kills the installer mid-copy and asserts no ownerless skill dir exists, before adding traps + staging. If ambiguous, pause and ask.

## Verification
From the repo root:
1. bash scripts/test_install.sh (end to end, green)
2. the interrupted-install repro shows no ownerless copies
3. git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
dependencies: scripts/install_lib.sh and scripts/test_install.sh present at pinned base (probed; note corrected path vs ticket)

success_criteria: interrupted-install repro produces zero ownerless skill copies

output_expectations.summary: Trap coverage added, the staging/atomic-move flow, and the repro evidence.
output_expectations.next_step: ready-for-review handoff; human reviews and opens the PR

allow: Run the slice verification commands incl. the kill-mid-copy repro against a temp install target
Create/commit on a local work branch (vic/bei-130-*)
ask: Any edit outside the include scope
Changing what counts as user-owned vs beislid-owned
deny: git push, PR creation, or any remote write
Running the installer against the real user skills directory (use a temp target)

routing.reason: staging + trap convention pre-decided; repro is the gate
